mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has risen monotonically from -28.7 to -21.3 over four weekly means, the steepest recovery of any series. Household provisioning trips normalize first and re-establish out-of-home routines, which pulls discretionary RETAIL_REC up over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 7.4 points across t-3w to t-0w, fastest of all six categories
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM continuing to rise.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has climbed from -70.4 to -68.6 and is the upstream input to store-based shopping trips. Once the TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -68.0, transit-dependent shoppers reach retail corridors and RETAIL_REC rises over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 1.8 points from t-3w (-70.4) to t-0w (-68.6)
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above -68.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has fallen from 23.0 to 22.1 while WORKPLACES has risen from -55.6 to -54.0. The joint release of home-bound time into commuting time is the strongest signal of routine restoration, and it lifts weekday RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL down 0.9 and WORKPLACES up 1.6 points over the four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days when RESIDENTIAL declines and WORKPLACES rises in the same week.

mechanism_narrative: Under an easing-restrictions regime, TRANSIT and WORKPLACES move together as legal caps on movement are lifted. Their parallel four-week rise signals a policy-driven reopening impulse that propagates to RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improved in each successive weekly mean from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks where both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve, RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is flat or lower versus the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has gained 7.4 points while RETAIL_REC has gained only 3.7 points. The widening gap shows trip substitution into essential provisioning rather than discretionary spending, so RETAIL_REC drifts lower over the next four weeks relative to the last four.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC weekly mean exceeds 45 points
evidence_refs: fact:t-0w gap = -21.3 - (-67.4) = 46.1 points, wider than the 42.4-point gap at t-3w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days while the GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap stays above 45 points.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS fell from -17.7 to -20.6 even as transit and grocery recovered, indicating a seasonal shift of recreation from outdoor to indoor venues. Displaced outdoor activity is redirected to indoor retail-and-recreation destinations, raising RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below -20.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined from -17.7 at t-3w to -20.6 at t-0w while TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM rose
failure_condition: After PARKS holds below -20.0 for two weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than or equal to the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has flattened near -54 with only a 1.6-point four-week gain, showing that workplace-directed restrictions remain binding. Without a commuting base, weekday retail footfall cannot grow, so RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks stays at or below the last four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES fails to rise above -54.0 in the next weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved only from -55.6 to -54.0 across four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -54.0.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has declined in every weekly mean, from 23.0 to 22.1. A drop below 22.2 removes the stay-at-home drag on discretionary trips within one week, producing an immediate rise in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined monotonically 23.0, 22.6, 22.3, 22.1 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: After RESIDENTIAL prints below 22.2, the following week's RETAIL_REC does not exceed the week in which RESIDENTIAL was last at or above 22.2.
